hookId.description: The hook that gives the data, found or built: dugout_…. null only when no hook gives any of it and no connector could

built.description: true when you created or changed a hook in this run; false when you found one that fits

input.description: The inputs it ran with, as a page sends them

covers.description: What the design shows that it gives, each with its path from the root of the output, [] for each item of a list: team crest → matches[].teams[0].logo

missing.description: What the design shows that it does not give

why.description: Found: why this hook over the others looked at. Built: which connector, and what the transform does. A line or two

existing.description: Only when a hook of dugout's was already there and you built a new one anyway: which, and what it lacks for the need (a field, or the grouping the design reads). Not that its envelope differs: the page binds any shape
